speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. No known chronic diseases. Social history: Occasionally consumes alcohol. Non-smoker. Works as a bank clerk.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies recent infections, fever, weight loss, vision changes or seizures. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Cellulitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy with Brainstem Compression or ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis). The patient's symptoms of progressive gait difficulty, urinary incontinence, and dysarthria are inconsistent with cellulitis, which is a localized skin infection; this suggests a central nervous system pathology.
